description: Use this when the user asks to cancel a paid order or to close an unpaid one. It cancels a paid order under its terms, or closes an unpaid one. It takes the orderId and exactly one of maximumPenalty (a paid order) and close: true (an unpaid one). Paid (the order's Cancel line says it can be cancelled): pass maximumPenalty, the penalty on that line exactly as shown. The order becomes cancelling, then cancelled with the refund on its way, or confirmed again if the hotel refuses. If the penalty rose above maximumPenalty, the answer is cancellation_changed and nothing changed. Unpaid (the Cancel line says it can be closed): close: true closes it: nothing is charged, and it can no longer be paid. A mode that does not fit the order (close on an order paid meanwhile) answers order_not_cancellable, which says which mode applies now or what blocks both: nothing is cancelled or closed by the other mode. While a payment is under way the answer is payment_in_progress. The same call again answers the order as it is.

close.description: Send true to close an unpaid order: nothing is charged. Send exactly one of close and maximumPenalty.

maximumPenalty.description: Send it to cancel a paid order: the penalty the user agreed to, as a ceiling. It is the penalty the order says a cancellation now keeps, exactly as the order gives it (cancel.penalty). Send exactly one of close and maximumPenalty.

amount.description: Decimal string such as 132.40, never a number.

orderId.description: The orderId of the order to cancel.

name: cancel_order
title: Cancel order
